Field Descriptions

id - csr.status.cfg_id.id[15:0]

Bus[15:8], Device[7:3] and Function[2:0] of this EP, as the TL captured them from the last Type 0 Configuration Write (UG477 cfg_bus_number, cfg_device_number, cfg_function_number). The firmware puts this value in the Completer ID of every Completion it sends. It is 0 until the host has configured the EP, and its bus number depends on the topology: behind a switch it is not the same as on a direct link.
